The Sagittarius Moon trines your sign, too, adding a confident glow. Gather proof of your biggest wins and ask for the promotion or pay bump you’ve earned. Let your track record speak for itself.

Few things test your patience like someone loading a car trunk all wrong. Your spatial genius is begging to take over, Virgo. Their way might work out fine. If not, you’ll get your turn.

Jupiter’s square to Mercury makes every big decision sound simple. Luckily, the Moon trines Saturn later, asking you to look at your schedule and budget first. If everything checks out, bring home your new best friend.

Kid-you was probably already balancing a checkbook. The Sagittarius Moon trines Saturn today, joining Mars in a fiery grand trine that makes room for fun without derailing your goals, Capricorn. Uranus’s sextile to Saturn adds a dash of spontaneity. Your ambitions will still be there tomorrow. Go play mini golf or ride a go-kart after work. Responsible adults need recess too.

Pointless rules give you hives. That outdated policy at work or in your building has you ready to stage a protest, Aquarius. The Moon opposes Uranus early, cranking up the urge to rebel. Uranus’s sextile to Saturn suggests a smarter route: propose a better system in writing. Gather a few allies who feel the same way. Organized revolutions get results.

Memory and imagination share a wall in your brain. You could swear a friend promised to help this weekend, but the details are fuzzy, Pisces. Neptune is retrograde, making it easy to mix up dreams and plans. Its trine with Mars ends today, giving you one last push to sort it out. Send a quick confirmation text. Your weekend self will thank you.
